subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Knights of Favonius' headquarters

414111501.text: Venti might be here already, let's take a look inside!

414111502.text: Halt! Citizens, what noble errand brings you?

414111503.text: Is Kaeya here? We need him for something.

414111504.text: Captain Kaeya? He's on duty in Jean's office.

414111505.text: Eh? Why is he in Jean's office?

414111506.text: The Windblume Festival celebrations have always been hosted by the Knights of Favonius. During the festivities, Master Jean personally goes out on patrol.

414111507.text: Captain Kaeya takes over her administrative duties during that period.

414110103.text: I was just thinking about you two, and now here you are. How fortuitous!

414110104.text: Kaeya, did you do your homework?

414110105.text: I'm afraid I must disappoint you... I haven't even started writing it yet.

414110106.text: Hmm, students that don't hand in their homework on time aren't exactly model students now, are they?

414110107.text: And what excuse does Kaeya have for not handing in his homework?

414110108.text: Well, as you can see, I'm helping Master Jean take care of various matters.

414110109.text: Mondstadt is a hive of activity over the festive period. Accordingly, there's a multitude of things that need sorting. *sigh* I've been at it for a good while now.

414110110.text: Traveler... can I ask for a favor?

414110111.text: I have a drinking buddy that wants me to help him with something, but I'm much too busy. Can I entrust this matter to you?

414110112.text: A drinking buddy? A friend you met at the tavern?

414110113.text: That's right. I often go to the tavern when not on duty. Somehow, I seem to have made quite a few acquaintances that way.

414110114.text: His name is Nimrod, he's never far from the tavern. He should be free right now.

414110115.text: Thanks for the help. I'd better stay behind and get started on my homework.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go look for Nimrod at the tavern

414111402.text: You must be Nimrod! Kaeya mentioned there was something you wanted him to take care of. He's busy right now, but we can help.

414111403.text: ...Huh? Oh, Traveler... I didn't realize it was you.

414111404.text: ...It's like this: I'm planning to give a gift to my wife for the Windblume Festival, and I wanted my drinking buddy, Kaeya, to come up with a gift idea.

414111405.text: ...I—I'm afraid I'm a bit of a drunkard, I'm nearly always in the tavern. My wife hates me drinking, so we're constantly arguing.

414111407.text: I can empathize, I don't mind a drink or two myself! Then again, and I'm not one to judge, but by the looks of your drinking habits... hmm...

414111408.text: I know... She's right, of course. I feel like I have to make it up to her.

414111409.text: ...Traveler, can you help me gather some materials? I want to make a gift for her myself.

414111410.text: ...I should have made preparations in advance, but I've barely been sober these last few days. I fell asleep, and when I woke up the celebrations had already begun! Now I'll never have time to finish it by myself...

414111411.text: Yeesh, this guy is a mess...

414111412.text: ...Single folks in Mondstadt would never dare get others to help them during the festive period. It's lucky you're already married, Nimrod.

414111413.text: Uh-huh... you're telling me... *sigh* I'm sorry... Here I am making a fool of myself in front of all of you.

414111414.text: *sigh* What's done is done. Spit it out then, how can we help?

414111415.text: I'm going to look for wood in the city, and we'll need plants to place inside. Those only grow in the wild, could I ask you to retrieve them? I need two stems of Small Lamp Grass.

414111416.text: Small Lamp Grass and wood... what are you making, exactly?

414111417.text: I want to make her a little wooden house, with glowing flowers and handmade furniture inside...

414111419.text: A token of my love, haha. ...Back when I'd only just gotten to know her, I used to make handmade gifts for her all the time... She loved them, she even used to say that...

414111420.text: Oh! Uh — ahem, excuse me. Let's put the past aside for the moment. Thank you all for your help.

414111421.text: Lucky you came across such kind-hearted assistants, hmm?

414111422.text: Alright, let's go and find those materials!

414110201.text: ...I haven't done any carpentry for a long time now. I hope everything goes to plan!

414110301.text: ...Thank you, thank you so much! With these materials, I can get to work straight away.

414110302.text: Remember, a gift can't solve everything! You need to start being fair to your wife, too!

414110304.text: *sigh* I do hope she likes my gift, though...

414110305.text: Everyone likes a gift given with love, don't worry.

414110306.text: Make it a good one! Don't go wasting those materials, they weren't easy to find y'know!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go back to the Knights' headquarters and report to Kaeya

414110501.text: We're back! Kaeya, have you finished?

414110502.text: Time to hand in your homework!

414110503.text: Welcome back, I'm just finishing up.

414110504.text: Go, go, go, hand it in, hand it in!

414110505.text: Alright, alright... Now then, no hurting my feelings.

414110507.text: Tone-Deaf Bard, what grade did he get?

414110508.text: Kaeya, may I read this out loud?

414110511.text: "Mi muhe ye\nMeans I love you\nIn the language of the hilichurls."

414110515.text: Coherent and to the point. Plus, the length seems about right.

414110516.text: What!? Are you writing a Hilichurlian phrase book!?

414110519.text: Hahaha, a love poem has to convey the style of its author, you know?

414110520.text: I'm not sure you took the exercise seriously.

414110521.text: Wait... so we're just gonna gloss over the fact that Kaeya can speak Hilichurlian? Weird.

414110522.text: Haha, don't underestimate the hidden knowledge of the Knights of Favonius' Cavalry Captain!

414110523.text: Alright then, time to collect the next student's homework...

414110525.text: I just caught sight of a suspicious figure, I must go and investigate. Traveler, I have another small task for you.

414110526.text: The Church has applied to us for a hunting license. Please take these official documents to the Cathedral.

414110701.text: Lisa, we need to establish some ground rules... If we do end up apprehending any drunken troublemakers, no electrocutions. Okay?

414110702.text: Oh Jean, you misunderstand me. That intoxicated fellow you witnessed last time was practically begging me to be shocked. It makes me wonder if some people don't actually quite enjoy getting—

414110704.text: *sigh* Very well then, if you insist.

414110706.text: Greetings, ladies! It's been a while.

414110707.text: What are you two doing here?

414110708.text: A while indeed. As you can see, Lisa and I are on duty.

414110709.text: Aww, it's cutie and friends. Did you see any suspicious people on the way here? If you do see anything, report straight to the Knights.

414110710.text: Since when do librarians go out on patrol?

414110711.text: Rarely, but this is the Windblume Festival, and they need all hands on deck. Even the humble clerical staff, like me.

414110712.text: Lisa, "humble clerical staff" do not wield Electro the way you do.

414110713.text: *sigh* Please do not be alarmed, I will keep my eyes on Lisa. Especially since she seems to enjoy electrocuting people just to break up a scuffle. Not to mention shocking drunkards until they beg for mercy...

414110714.text: If you don't like it, I can happily refrain.

414110715.text: Is that a promise? Good. Otherwise, I'm going to have to reconsider whether I want a librarian on patrol with me.

414110716.text: Paimon never knew being on patrol could be so exciting!

414110801.text: Barbara, Kaeya sent us to deliver the—

414110802.text: How dare they! This is sheer intimidation!

414110806.text: I... *sniff* I—I received a letter... *sniff* It says... I—It says...

414110807.text: Let me. I just came back from the wilderness. As usual, I came by the Cathedral to ask the sisters to patch me up. That's when I saw Barbara running out, white as a sheet. She was holding a letter.

414110808.text: I've never received a letter like this before...

414110810.text: Hm... "Dear Barbara, I've stolen the thing most precious to you and buried it." Huh... Could this be an attempt at intimidation?

414110811.text: It's awful... is it a joke? If so, we don't need to worry. But...

414110813.text: There's a map on the back, isn't that out in the wilderness?

414110814.text: Hmm... the thing most precious to you...

414110816.text: Huh... that location on the map is familiar, I've definitely been there before.

414110817.text: So what is the thing most precious to you?

414110818.text: I can't think straight right now, nothing makes sense... *whimpers*

414110819.text: It's coming to me... It's coming to me...

414110820.text: The thing most precious to me... W—Wait, could it be? Oh no!

414110822.text: Aha! I've got it! The Thousand Winds Temple!

414110824.text: Why are they in such a hurry? Let's catch up with them!

414111005.text: I ran into Jean a moment ago, Lisa was with her. She's fine.

414111009.text: That letter. Give it to me.

414111011.text: ...If they're not talking about Jean in the letter... then what are they talking about?

414111012.text: Did you really think they'd buried Jean underground!? What a horrible thought!

414111013.text: So, Sister, have you found any leads?

414111014.text: Looking at the map, the perpetrator seems to have marked out an area around Dawn Winery.

414111015.text: That's open land, so hiding something there... Hmm, what could it be?

414111016.text: Nice work! How did you figure that out so quickly?

414111017.text: Although... Dawn Winery? That's not the place we were thinking...

414111019.text: Barbara, rather than letting your imagination get the better of you, stand up and face this head-on.

414111021.text: Hehe, it's a little scary, right? That's why we're going with you. What do you say?

414111023.text: And you, Sister? Will you be accompanying us?

414111024.text: No need... I knew straight away there was nothing to worry about.

414111025.text: Eh? And what does that mean?

414111027.text: Barbara, are you feeling a bit better now?

414111029.text: Rosaria is right, better to know the ways of the enemy than stand here scaring myself.

414111031.text: Thank you, all of you. Let's get to the location and see what we find.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the location marked out on the map

414111302.text: What is this? Hmm... quick, let's open it!

414111304.text: ...Interesting... such an exquisite gift box. What's it doing out here in the wilderness?

414111306.text: Wow, what a beautiful Windwheel Aster wreath! And so many paper stars!

414111309.text: Hmm... looks like our "perpetrator" is really just one of Barbara's fans.

414111310.text: There's a note! What does it say? Hmm, let's see...

414111311.text: "So sorry to get your attention this way. Please accept this Windblume as a sign of my sincere admiration for your virtue and sweetness."

414111312.text: Huh? So it's... fraudulent intimidation, then?

414111313.text: Be it for the gods or that special someone, flowers should be offered in utmost sincerity. It's the most important ceremony of the Windblume Festival.

414111314.text: Flowers of love and blessings, sent on such a special occasion... No effort should be spared to make it spectacular.

414111315.text: Behind the questionable methodology... here we have a meticulously thought-out and heartfelt gift.

414111316.text: Heh... laying it on a little thick, aren't we...? Still seems like someone with a few screws loose to Paimon...

414111317.text: Hahaha, maybe you're right. I think I have a suspect in mind who fits that description...

414111319.text: (I think I know the answer too.)

414111320.text: Shh! No telling, now... I'd like Paimon to make a few guesses.

414119901.text: Feel free to take your time... I need to channel my inner poet.
